faq.q: What are the steps to sell a home with Jared, according to the page?
faq.a: Eight steps: a free first chat; pricing from recent nearby sales and current listings; getting ready with cleaning, small repairs and decluttering; professional photos, video, floor plans and drone photos, then MLS® listing; showings with feedback after each one; offers walked through on price, deposit, conditions and dates; conditions and the cooling-off period; and closing through a lawyer or notary, with keys on possession day.

faq.q: Can a buyer back out after I accept their offer?
faq.a: For most homes, yes, inside the Home Buyer Rescission Period: the buyer may rescind within three business days after acceptance, and the brokerage then pays the seller the 0.25% rescission fee directly and returns the balance of the deposit to the buyer, with no release form required.

faq.q: Do I pay tax if I sell soon after buying?
faq.a: Possibly the BC home flipping tax: it applies to profit on a BC property owned less than 730 days, at 20% of net taxable income within 365 days, gradually decreasing to no tax at 730 days, under the Residential Property (Short-Term Holding) Profit Tax Act effective January 1, 2025, with a return due within 90 days of the sale where the tax applies.
